text: わかいのに　ニュースに　きょうみが　あるとは　かんしん　じゃのう　わしに　ニュースを　みせてくれた　おれいに　これを　やろう！

structure.jp: ニュースに　きょうみが　あるとは
structure.en: to think you're interested in the news

structure.jp: かんしん　じゃのう
わしに　ニュースを　みせてくれた　おれいに
structure.en: as thanks for showing me the news

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', with a feeling of surprise. わかいのに = 'even though you're young'.

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a statement shows the speaker is surprised or impressed by it, like 'to think that...'. きょうみが あるとは = 'to think you have an interest'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form verb says someone did it as a favour to the speaker. みせてくれた = 'kindly showed me'.
